create_swa_optimizer: create a StochasticWeightAveraging optimizer wrapping SGD with auto mode starting at step 10
update_swa_averages: update the SWA running averages for all optimized parameters in the model
finalize_swa_swap: finalize training by swapping optimized variables with SWA running average buffers
update_batchnorm_stats: update BatchNorm running mean and variance buffers using a data loader pass
build_swa_from_config: build a StochasticWeightAveraging optimizer from a Config object and PyTorch model
